notes: Extra busy headers are backend-seeded status rows, not additional live executions. The six canonical stream producers remain unchanged. Busy-header variants must not be pooled with the default workload.
mainThreadMs and mainThreadMsPerSecond use TaskDuration with timeTicks: elapsed time in main-thread tasks, not thread CPU time. Script, style, and layout durations use the same elapsed-time domain.
mainThreadCpuMs uses ThreadTime (renderer main-thread CPU). rendererCpuMs uses ProcessTime (renderer-process CPU); it excludes separate browser, GPU, and backend processes.
Positive reduction means a lower candidate value. Counts such as mounted editors are observations, not optimization scores.
Final-content probe versions must not be pooled. Locator-assertion retries can collect page-wide ARIA snapshots; boolean polling retains the same visibility gate without those snapshots.
Streaming duration includes the wait for final visible content. Fixed-deadline traffic is retained in the raw report.
Frame gaps and driver DOM readiness are not INP. Linux CPU throttling is not an M2 Air simulation.
History decoded bytes include captured requests and responses. They are not compressed network transfer.

switches. Visible reveal performed nine reads versus seven. This is work

hidden-changes-navigation-startup-failure/. The same mock-agent and agentctl
helpers as the candidate were added to the frozen bundle and hash-checked
against the preceding timestamp baseline. Application binary/assets did not
change. This setup error establishes no performance result.

matched-navigation-1792829729312.json;
hidden-changes-navigation-two-pair-summary.json;
hidden-changes-navigation-two-pair-retry-logs/kandev-run.e2e.aPyyjvTD.log.
It completed 160 timed switches plus 200 retention switches, keeping one editor
and three panels in both arms. Style time fell 6.08% and 9.13%; long-task count
fell 13.39% and 9.24%. Main-thread CPU changed by +0.58% and -0.63%; renderer CPU
changed by +1.01% and -0.40%. Median readiness was mixed (+1.37%, -2.18%);
p95 improved 0.35% and 1.75%. These are preliminary targeted rendering gains,
not evidence of a meaningful overall CPU or navigation-speed gain. The separate six-pair confirmation passed; its complete results are included here.
limits: Style time, style-recalculation count, layout count, and long-task count fell in all six pairs. This is the basis for retaining the targeted rendering fix.
Main-thread and renderer CPU fell in five pairs; the first pair regressed by 4.48% and 3.73%.
Median paired p95 switch readiness was 0.14% slower, with four slower pairs and two faster pairs. No p95 navigation-speed gain is established.
Per-arm switch times rose during the series. Alternating order and all raw samples are retained; the cause of the drift is not established.
Native getter attribution adds overhead and is separate from timing. No hidden reads does not mean no hidden React work.
One initial phone deep-tree scroll failure is preserved with an unconfirmed cause; unchanged baseline and candidate reruns passed.
These Linux Chromium measurements do not establish M2 Air speed, battery life, field INP, or a memory leak.
Final original-baseline grid, columns, Dockview and stress coverage remains open in completion-audit.md.
